description: Get a trivia fact about a specific number, a batch of random integers, or today's curated number of the day. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

action.description: Which lookup to perform. 'fact' needs number; 'random' returns one or more random integers; 'number-of-the-day' returns today's curated pick.

category.description: For action 'number-of-the-day': the category shortname. Defaults to the site's default category.

number.description: Required when action is 'fact' — the number to look up.

total.description: For action 'random': how many numbers to return (capped server-side).

name: number-facts
title: Number Facts Tool
